user.title: Sobry
user.description: Paste the API key generated from your Sobry customer area (Profile → API key). It is read-only (price:read) and tied to a single contract.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Sobry
reauth_confirm.description: Your API key is no longer valid (expired or revoked). Generate a new one from your Sobry customer area and paste it here.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid, expired or revoked API key.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the Sobry API.

init.title: Price colour thresholds
init.description: Set the price levels (€/kWh incl. tax): green at or below the green threshold, yellow in between, red above the red threshold.
